rollback_or_rollforward: Reversible: downgrade drops the tenant-isolation RLS policies (and disables FORCE/RLS) on every northstar_analytics table, then drops identity_stitch, event and event_definition and the northstar_analytics schema (CASCADE). event holds the authoritative first-party analytics records and identity_stitch holds consent-backed identity links, so on a shared environment export the schema first (uninstall policy export_then_delete) and restore from the pre-migration backup rather than dropping in place. Registered event definitions are immutable, so this migration never mutates data in place.

prechecks: database is a supported PostgreSQL version
postchecks: northstar_analytics schema with event_definition, event and identity_stitch tables exists
row-level security is enabled and forced on every northstar_analytics table with a tenant-isolation policy keyed to the northstar.tenant_id GUC

compatibility_window: Phase 7 analytics module (purpose-governed event catalog, validating first-party ingestion pipeline, consent-aware identity stitching, first-party reach reporting, optional non-authoritative GA4 adapter) baseline
